analysis.title: Canadian Natural Resources Ltd. (CNQ): To Expand Natural Gas Footprint Through C$2.53 Bn Acquisition of Advantage Energy
key_insights: CNQ announced on 11/16, before market open, a definitive agreement to acquire Advantage Energy (AAV.TO) in an all-cash deal valued at C$2.53 bn enterprise value.

Offer is C$13.55/sh cash, a ~25% premium to AAV.TO's C$10.87 close on 11/13. Implied equity value is ~C$2.255 bn fully diluted. EV includes AAV net debt and C$143.75 mn of 5% convertible unsecured subordinated debentures due 2029.

The deal adds ~79,000 BOE/d of Montney and Charlie Lake production at ~C$32,000 per flowing BOE/d, plus a deep inventory of light crude oil and liquids-rich natural gas locations next to CNQ's Grande Prairie operations.
Acquired infrastructure includes the 425 MMcf/d Glacier Gas Plant and the newly commissioned 75 MMcf/d Progress Gas Plant.
CNQ plans to fund the deal with cash on hand and existing bank credit facilities, and to keep returning 100% of free cash flow to shareholders through share repurchases, subject to market conditions.

Closing is targeted for 1Q27 through a plan of arrangement under the Business Corporations Act (Alberta). Management expects the deal to be accretive and to deliver scale synergies and better area efficiencies.
GS keeps its Buy rating on CNQ with a 12-month DCF/SOTP-based price target of US$59, 18.6% above the US$49.75 close on 11/13. Key risks are commodity prices, capital spend and operational execution.

market_movers.rationale: GS reiterates Buy with a 12-month DCF/SOTP price target of US$59, implying 18.6% upside from US$49.75. The note treats the Advantage Energy acquisition as a strategic fit.

earnings_insights: GS estimates for CNQ (C$): EPS 3.56 for 12/25, 6.77 for 12/26E, 6.17 for 12/27E and 5.49 for 12/28E. These are GS forecasts except for 12/25.
GS quarterly EPS (C$): 2.19 for 6/26, 1.47 for 9/26E, 1.95 for 12/26E and 1.52 for 3/27E. The note does not label 6/26 as reported or estimated.
